add.about: Adds a client: their name, and their city and email when known. Answers the client as kept, with its id.

find.about: Finds clients: those in a city, those whose name or email holds a text, or all of them. Answers each with its id, name, city and email.

city.description: Only the clients in this city.

text.description: Only those whose name or email holds this.

note.about: Writes a note on a client, by the client's id.

client.description: The client's id, as find answers it.

notes.about: The notes on a client, the newest first.
